elements.description: Background agent tasks as a board (or list): Needs you, Running, Done.

properties.name: tasks
properties.description:
The tasks – always the source of truth. After Approve, Reject or Retry the card shows the result right away;
as soon as you pass that task with a new status (or steps, start or elapsed time), your version wins

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Heading on the left of the bar

properties.name: action
properties.description: A button in the bar, e.g. { label: "New task", onClick } – Standard look only; the Clean bar has no button

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: The id of the unfolded card, or null

properties.name: openable
properties.description: Shows an Open button on running and done tasks (fires tc-open)

properties.name: onApprove
properties.description: Called on Approve; may return a promise

properties.name: onReject
properties.description: Called on Reject; may return a promise

properties.name: onRetry
properties.description: Called on Retry; may return a promise

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-view-change
events.description: The user switched Board / List ({ view }: AgentInboxViewChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-expanded-change
events.description: A card was unfolded or folded ({ expanded }: AgentInboxExpandedChange, null = none); cancelable

events.name: tc-open
events.description: Open was pressed on a running or done task; `detail` is the `AgentTask`

props.name: tasks
props.description: The tasks – always the source of truth; a decision shows at once, and your next version of the task wins

props.name: title
props.description: Heading on the left of the bar

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Shows an Open button on running and done tasks

props.name: view
props.description: The layout. Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps it, starting from `defaultView`

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The layout at first when `view` isn't controlled

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the layout the user picked, controlled or not

props.name: expanded
props.description: The id of the unfolded card. Controlled when defined (null = none); otherwise the component keeps it

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: The card unfolded at first when `expanded` isn't controlled

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the id of the card the user unfolded, or null when they folded it
